name: Amanuensis
body:
System Akashic

Those who seek to find the lost language of magic often forget that it possesses a written form, an ancient and powerful script whose strokes hold dreadful power. If speaking the language of magic causes reality to bend, how far would writing those syllables twist the world?

Parent Class: Protean Scribe.

Hit Die: d6.

Class Skills

The amanuensis’s class skills are Appraise (Int), Bluff (Cha), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (all) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Perform (oratory) (Cha), Profession (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Use Magic Device (Cha)

Skill Ranks Per Level: 4 + Int modifier

Table: Amanuensis

Class Features

The following are the class features of this class.

Tools of the Scribe (Su)

At 1st level the amanuensis gains a tome and stylus bound to them that represents their connection to the Akashic Record. They are always treated as having the Book and Quill of the Akashic Record veil shaped, without it being counted against their limit of shaped veils or it taking up their hands slot and treating it as if it were invested with essence equal to half your amanuensis level (rounded down, minimum 1). The veil granted by this ability cannot benefit from Akashic Catalysts or similar effects that expand the essence capacity of essence receptacles.

In addition, the amanuensis may use the stylus to write on any surface as per the arcane mark cantrip with a caster level equal to their amanuensis level.

At 2nd level, the amanuensis gains the veil’s Hands bind effect and their book and quill of the akashic record veil gains additional power whenever they shatter veils, being treated as if it were invested with +1 additional essence whenever they have at least 1 veil shattered for as long as the shattered veil remains suppressed.

At 10th level the amanuensis treats their book and quill of the akashic record as if it were invested with +2 additional essence whenever they have at least 3 veils shattered for as long as the shattered veils remain suppressed.

Runeweaving

An amanuensis learns to shape the magical power known as akasha into powerful veils. Rather than drawing veils from a codified list, each amanuensis develops their own unique selection of veils based on their knowledge of the primordial words drawn from the akashic record. This knowledge is based on a mixture of their own research and the intuition and insight into the language they gain as they grow. At 1st level, the amanuensis chooses a number of veils equal to their Wisdom modifier + 2 (minimum 3) and treats those selected veils as their veil list. These veils must have either the Brand, Shatter, or Title descriptors. At each level thereafter they may choose an additional veil following the above limitations to add to their list of veils known.

The amanuensis uses Wisdom as their veilweaving modifier, and has a veilweaving level equal to their class level. The saving throw DCs of the amanuensis’s veils are equal to 10 + the essence invested in the veil + their Wisdom modifier. The amanuensis may choose to remove the title descriptor from a veil to shape and bind it upon themselves normally.

At 1st level, the amanuensis gains the ability to shape a limited number of veils each day. They can shape 1 veil at 1st level, and gain the ability to shape 1 additional veil each day at 4th level and every 3rd level thereafter (for a total of 7 veils at 19th level). This ability is treated as the veilweaving ability for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.

Primal Words

Veils shaped by an amanuensis are composed of glowing runes, and as such their effects are vulnerable to erase spells and similar effects. An erase spell cast on an amanuensis’s veil is treated as a targeted dispel magic check following the normal rules for dispelling veils. A amanuensis’s veils and their effects can also be identified with a Linguistics or Knowledge (Arcana) skill check, though the personal styles of each amanuensis obscure this check, adding +5 to the normal DC to Identify their veils.

Essence Pool

At 1st level, the amanuensis gains access to a pool of essence which can be invested into their veils and other essence receptacles to increase their power. The amanuensis gains 1 point of essence at each class level, plus a bonus point of essence at 1st, 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th levels (for a total of 25 essence at level 20).

The amanuensis’s character level, as noted in the Akasha and Magic Interactions section, determines the maximum quantity of essence they can invest in any single veil. As a swift action, an amanuensis can reallocate their essence investments into or between their veils and other essence receptacles.

Akashic Embellishment

At 1st level, the amanuensis gains the ability to augment their veils in various ways by weaving treasures of pure essence into their veils, known as Akashic Treasures. An amanuensis begins play knowing a number of akashic treasures equal to 2 + their Wisdom modifier (minimum 3), and may adorn a single veil with one of them as part of shaping their veils for the day.

At 4th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, they learn 2 additional akashic treasures and may adorn an additional veil each day. They cannot adorn the same veil multiple times, nor can they place the same treasure on multiple veils (unless specified otherwise by the treasure).

Ruinous Calligraphy (Su)

Starting at 1st level the amanuensis begins to learn powerful words in the primordial language drawn from the akashic record. They learn the following ability and can use it with their Book and Quill of the Akashic Record:

Invective: Your stylus writes a primordial word that leaps forth to assault your opponent directly. As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack with your stylus against a target within Close range (25ft+5ft/2 amanuensis levels), dealing damage as normal and applying the effects of the chosen ink. If the amanuensis is 2nd level or higher, before rolling this attack they may change which ink they are currently using with their stylus as a free action.

At 2nd level and every 4 levels thereafter, you learn one of the following phrases that can be used with your Book and Quill of the Akashic Record:

Adjective: You use your stylus to write primordial words that paint a picture of devastation upon the world. As a standard action, arcs of energy burst forth through your stylus out into your choice of one of the following effects: a 5ft radius + 5ft per 5 amanuensis levels emanation centered on you, a 15ft cone + 5ft per 5 amanuensis levels, or a 30ft line + 5ft per 3 amanuensis levels. Make a single attack roll with your stylus and apply it against the AC of any creatures of your choice within the area of this effect, with successful attacks dealing damage as normal and applying the effects of the chosen ink. If this attack is a critical threat, roll a critical confirmation against each creature individually. Using this ability does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
Adverb: You use your stylus to write primordial words that alter the probability of your strokes. As a standard action, make a single attack with your stylus or tome. If you make an attack with your stylus, it must be made against a target within its first ranged increment. You gain a +2 insight bonus to that attack roll, +1 per 3 amanuensis levels. This bonus replaces the normal insight bonus to attack rolls granted by investing essence in that veil.
Conjunction: Your stylus writes primordial words that tie the fates of multiple targets to the same outcome. As a standard action, choose a target within 10 feet + 5 feet per 5 amanuensis levels from you and a second target within the same distance from the first. Make a melee attack using your stylus against each target in the order they are chosen, dealing damage as normal on a successful attack and applying the effects of the chosen ink.. Should any of the targets fail to take damage, either by a missed attack, resistances, or other method, the chain stops and no further targets are attacked or damaged. For every 5 amanuensis levels you possess you may choose up to one additional target, and no target can be farther than 10 feet + 5 feet per 5 veilweaving levels from the previous target and no target can be chosen more than once.
Determiner: You use your stylus to write primordial words held in check, creating runes of dangerous energy that orbit you. As a standard action, choose a single ink type available to your stylus. A rune colored in that energy splits off to orbit you similarly to an ioun stone that lasts for one minute per amanuensis level or until discharged. You may maintain 1 rune at a time, + 1 additional rune per 5 amanuensis levels. You may use this ability as a full-round action to form multiple runes, up to the maximum you can maintain. As an immediate action, you may discharge a single rune, allowing you to make an attack with the rune against a target within 5 feet, + 5 feet per 5 amanuensis levels as if it were your stylus. This attack does not provoke attacks of opportunity, and the rune deals damage equal to your Wisdom modifier plus any additional damage granted by invested essence of the type determined by the chosen ink, or twice that on a critical hit.
Interjection: You use your stylus to write primordial words that burst forth in a violent display. As a standard action, center a burst at a location within 20ft, +20ft per 5 amanuensis levels. This burst has a radius of 10ft, plus up to 5ft per 10 amanuensis levels. Make a single attack with your stylus and apply it against the AC of any creatures of your choice within this burst, with successful attacks dealing damage as normal and applying the effects of the chosen ink. If this attack is a critical threat, roll a critical confirmation against each creature individually. If this ability is centered beyond your melee reach, it provokes attacks of opportunity as normal.
Preposition: You use your stylus to write primordial words that shrink the distance between you and your target. As a standard action, choose a target within Close range (25 feet + 5 feet per 2 veilweaving levels) of you. You move in a straight line towards the nearest space adjacent to that target and then make a single attack with your stylus or tome against them. This path must be free of obstructions, but this movement can carry you through the air, through water or other liquids, or across gaps. If this movement cannot cause you to reach your target, this ability fails before you are moved (you may not necessarily know why the movement failed, in the case of supernatural effects). This movement provokes attacks of opportunity. You may pass through spaces occupied by other creatures as part of this movement by making an overrun maneuver as a free action against the targets. Creatures affected by this overrun are not granted an attack of opportunity against you, and you use your amanuensis level + your Wisdom modifier for this check. If a target attempts to impede you during this overrun, you deal damage to them as if you had hit them with your stylus on a successful check in addition to moving through them. Overrun attempts made using this ability do not provoke attacks of opportunity, do not knock affected targets prone, and an unsuccessful overrun attempt ends your movement and staggers you until the beginning of your next turn.

At 11th level when you use one of the above abilities and it affects more than one target, you may have each target affected by a different kind of ink available to your book and quill of the akashic record. Additionally, you may treat the effects as a special attack action against a single affected target when using one of the above abilities.

Creatures of Myth (Su)

At 1st level, the amanuensis’s writing gives order to disorder, and draws stories into reality. As a full-round action, they may draw forth one of their shaped veils and manifest it in the form of a legendary creature pulled from the akashic record. For the purpose of its abilities this creature is treated as an Unchained Eidolon by an unchained summoner of half their amanuensis level (minimum 1). It gains a subtype, base and bonus evolutions, and small sized base form as normal but gains no evolution points from the amanuensis’s class levels.

An amanuensis may only have a single legendary creature summoned at a time, but may choose different options for the summoned legendary creature each time they manifest one. While the veil is manifested as the lesser eidolon, the essence that was invested in the veil is treated as bound and the veil itself is treated as shattered for the purpose of feats and abilities. The amanuensis can dismiss their summoned creature as a move action, and should their summoned creature end their turn further than the amanuensis can maintain their titles, it is dismissed. Should the creature be dismissed or destroyed before 10 minutes have elapsed, then the veil it was manifested from remains suppressed for the remaining duration as if it were a veil that was shattered.

The eidolon gains the benefits of the veil (and any bind effects if it was bound) they were manifested from and any akashic treasures adorned upon it as if it were a title veil entitled on them by the amanuensis, and for each essence that was invested in the manifested veil the eidolon gains the following: +1 insight bonus to attack rolls, AC, and saving throws, a +2 insight bonus to damage rolls, 1 evolution point, and 5 temporary hit points. If lost, these temporary hit points recover at a rate of 1 hit point per round.

Master Linguist (Ex)

Beginning at 2nd level, an amanuensis adds their class level as a competence bonus on all Linguistics skill checks and they may use Wisdom in place of Intelligence when making Linguistics checks. At 3rd level, and each level thereafter, a protean scribe learns a new language.

Low Chakra Binding

At 3rd level, the amanuensis gains access to a low chakra bind. Each day when they shape their veils, they can choose whether they wish to bind veils to the Feet or Hands slot. At 6th level, they additionally can choose between the Head slot, and can choose two binds rather than one.

Binding Words

At 3rd level, the amanuensis’s mastery over their runes allows them to bind them for greater effect. Each day when the amanuensis shapes their veils for the day they can choose to give up one or more of their chakra binds granted by their low chakra binding, middle chakra binding, high chakra binding, or pinnacle chakra binding class features to instead gain the ability to bind one of their shaped [brand] or [title] descriptor veils. If the brand or title veil has multiple chakras it can be shaped to, the amanuensis chooses which chakra slot they treat it as bound to when they shape the veil. The amanuensis does not need to be able to normally bind veils to the chosen chakra.

Branding Strokes (Ex)

At 3rd level, the once per round when the amanuensis hits a creature within their melee reach with their stylus, they can apply one of their shaped brands to that creature as a free action (even outside of their turn). This otherwise functions as if the amanuensis had attempted to apply that brand to the creature normally, and follows the normal rules for brand veils (such as requiring a saving throw, if the brand required one to apply it) save the creature suffers a -2 penalty to any saves required by the brand. When applying a brand in this way the amanuensis may use the higher of their Wisdom score or the ability score they used to make the attack when determining the brand’s saving throws and effects that are based on their veilweaving modifier.

At 9th level, the amanuensis gains the Mass Branding feat as a bonus feat, ignoring its prerequisites or limitations. The amanuensis may now apply brands to targets affected by their Ruinous Calligraphy ability as if they were within their melee reach.

Finally at 15th level whenever the amanuensis attempts to apply a brand using this ability, the affected target takes a -4 penalty to any saves required by the brand and if you succeed in applying the brand they take additional piercing damage equal to your Wisdom modifier when it is applied, and again when it is removed or sundered.

Improved Essence Capacity

At 3rd, 9th and 15th level the amanuensis study of the akashic record has improved their ability to invest essence, increasing the maximum essence capacity of all their veils and essence receptacles by 1.

Written Reach (Ex)

At 4th level the amanuensis can maintain the effects caused by their primordial words further than normal. They can now maintain their brands, titles, and creatures of myth out to Medium range (100 feet + 10 feet per amanuensis level). At 11th level this increases to Long range (400ft + 40ft feet per amanuensis level).

At 19th the range you can maintain your titles, brands, and creatures of myth becomes limitless so long as they remain on the same plane as you.

Mystic Transcription (Su)

Beginning at 5th level, an amanuensis’s brushstrokes become so swift they are hard to follow with the eye. When scribing a mundane work to or from their bound tome, she can write up to 60 words per round (600 words per minute).

In addition, an amanuensis can transcribe the writings from minor magical scrolls into their bound tome, causing it to absorb their magic. At 5th level, they can transcribe 0th or 1st level spells from scrolls, and doing so requires 1 minute per spell level of the scroll, and causes it to transfer to a page in your bound tome. The amanuensis’ bound tome is treated as a scroll that can contain a total number of combined spell levels from transcribed scrolls equal to their Wisdom modifier (with 0th level spells being treated as 1/2 a spell level). Thereafter, once per day the amanuensis can cast the spell from the transcribed scroll as normal from their bound tome as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to their amanuensis level and using their Wisdom as their casting ability score. The amanuensis may substitute Linguistics skill checks for the Use Magic Device checks normally required to cast or copy spells from scrolls. Should the amanuensis decide to change what spells they have transcribed, they may do so as part of their meditations to shape veils for the day, the new spell replacing any number of spell levels transcribed in their tome. If a spell is removed from their tome for another, it is lost, and they must find another scroll with that spell to relearn it.

At 9th, 12th, and 15th levels, the amanuensis may transcribe spells from scrolls of 2nd, 3rd, and 4th level respectively, and can use them once each per day as spell-like abilities.

Stories Shared (Su)

At 7th level when the amanuensis entitles an ally they may choose to write lesser versions of it upon themselves. As a swift action, the amanuensis may choose a veil with the Title descriptor they currently have shaped on an ally or manifested as a creature of myth. The amanuensis gains the benefits of the chosen veil, using half the essence invested in that veil (rounded down, minimum 1) to determine the effects. If that veil is bound to a chakra, they do not gain its bind effects or abilities. If the chosen veil is unshaped or suppressed, the amanuensis loses the granted benefits. The amanuensis may change what veil they are benefiting from as a swift action, and may reinvest their essence as part of doing so.

At 14th level, the amanuensis may choose a second shaped title veil and gain the benefits of that veil following the same rules above.

Middle Chakra Bind

At 9th level, the amanuensis gains access to a middle chakra bind. Each day when they shape their veils, they can choose whether they wish to bind veils to the Wrists, Shoulders or Headband slots. At 12th level, they choose two binds rather than one.

Stories Upon Stories (Ex)

Starting at 10th level, the amanuensis can shape and bind shatter descriptor veils alongside non-shatter descriptor veils in the same chakra slot. Each veil still counts against your total limit of shaped and bound veils. This does not stack with other similar abilities, such as the Twin Veil feat.

Effortless Embellishment (Ex)

Beginning at 13th level, an amanuensis is so practiced at writing the primordial words of the akashic record, that she can write and maintain them almost effortlessly. Whenever an amanuensis adorns a veil with an akashic treasure, they treat that veil if it were invested with 2 additional points of essence for the purpose of determining the treasure’s effects.

High Chakra Binding

At 15th level, the amanuensis gains access to a high chakra bind. Each day when they shape their veils, they can choose whether they wish to bind veils to the Neck or Belt slot.

Redefine

At 17th level, when one of the amanuensis’s veils has been suppressed by being shattered for at least 10 minutes and is unsuppressed, you can unshape it and shape a new veil in its place as it is unsuppressed. The veil you shape in its place must be a valid veil for you to shape, and the chakra slot you shape it to must be a valid slot for it to be shaped in. If you are capable of binding the newly shaped veil (either being able to bind to the slot or through the Binding Words ability), you may bind it as part of this ability.

The amanuensis may take a point of essence burn to unshape one of their veils and shape a different veil in its place as a move action. If the unshaped veil was bound (or was a title or brand bound using their Binding Words class feature), you may take an additional 2 points of essence burn to immediately bind the newly shaped veil, should you have the ability to. If you do not, it is not considered bound until you spend 1 hour in meditation. If the veil that was unshaped had an akashic treasure adorned upon it, then that treasure can be changed as soon as you rebind the veil.

Pinnacle Chakra Binding

At 18th level, the amanuensis gains access to a pinnacle chakra bind. Each day when they shape their veils, they can choose whether they wish to bind veils to the Chest or Body slot.

Master Scribe (Su)

At 20th level, the primordial words written by an amanuensis become part of the world itself. Their Tools of the Scribe, Ruinous Calligraphy, and Creatures of Myth abilities are now considered extraordinary effects, rather than supernatural. They are not subject to spell resistance, and cannot be dispelled or suppressed by effects that suppress magic.
